summary_1line: King Pandu accidentally kills the sage Kindama disguised as a deer during mating and is cursed to die if he approaches his wife sexually.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Pandu in the forest releases golden-feathered arrows that strike a mating pair of deer on a wooded Himalayan slope.
The dying deer transforms in voice into the sage Kindama, lying pierced by arrows while reproaching Pandu in the forest.
Mortally wounded Kindama curses Pandu on the forest floor while his deer-mate stands beside him and the shocked king listens.
